_comment: Single source of truth for the release-asset layout of the prebuilt cores (xray / sing-box / tun2socks). Read by scripts/fetch-cores.sh (jq), nix/cores.nix (fromJSON) and scripts/update-core-hashes.sh (jq). Versions live in scripts/core-versions.sh (keyed by version_var). URL = https://github.com/<repo>/releases/download/<TAG>/<file>, where TAG is the version_var value and {ver} expands to TAG without the leading 'v'. member is the binary's name inside the archive (a glob; the extractor also matches member.exe on Windows). geodat2srs is intentionally absent: it ships no release artifacts and is built from source at GEODAT2SRS_REV.
